limits: Temporary homes and synthetic rollout content. Rollout content holds no tool results, so the tool role is checked only by check_supervised unit cases. The manifest (and so the hash comparison against a written manifest) is T006; units left out by the d4FirstAttempt filter are returned as a count but not recorded in the manifest. Trajectory records keep only the attempt's exported calls, so an excluded middle call leaves a gap inside turnRange.
outcome: passed: T004: lightning_export.supervised writes one canonical JSONL line per unit, {recordId, messages} (plus outcome with outcome_field), and a manifest record entry whose sha256 is the line's SHA-256 and which validates against the manifest schema's record item. In a temporary store with a D4 success (two calls, one with a tool call), a D4 failure and an attempt without a reward: transition without outcome_field writes the success's two calls (user prompt, assistant response with toolCalls) and leaves out two units; with outcome_field it writes all four with outcomes success, success, failure, unknown; trajectory merges the success's two calls into one record with turnRange [0, 1] and limit text-level-merge, and a one-call unit carries no limit. Output is in E3 order and identical for shuffled input; two attempts with identical text get distinct record ids and lines; no raw attempt id reaches a line or entry. check_supervised refuses an unknown role, non-text content, an unknown message or record key, a tool message without toolCallId, no messages, an outcome without the flag, a missing or invalid outcome with it, and a malformed record id (invalid-record); an unknown level or a non-boolean outcome_field is invalid-argument.
